task.title: Sherlock usage source identity and cumulative coverage

intent.goal: Correct historical and future usage query results without rewriting immutable telemetry.
must_happen: Collapse repeated native source occurrences before differencing.
Attribute Codex usage using preceding native turn context.
Retain measured prefix and return null authoritative tokens with per-group coverage when cumulative arithmetic is uncertain.
Carry pre-window discontinuities into the requested window.
must_not_happen: Count unexplained reset recovery as verified usage.
Infer billing or add token categories into a billed total.
Mutate existing raw records or versioned projections.
constraints: Query-side correction preserves current normalizer versions.
Source order uses native record coordinates, not upload order.
non_goals: Inferring clean counter epochs without source evidence
assumptions: Matching native session, range, and immutable full-record hash identify a repeated occurrence across uploads.

proof_obligations.claim: Native duplicates collapse while distinct positions remain distinct; model attribution follows preceding source context.
proof_obligations.verification: Real PostgreSQL fixtures with overlapping uploads, future context, and missing context.

proof_obligations.claim: Discontinuities cannot masquerade as zero or inflate usage; known prefixes and group uncertainty survive windowing.
proof_obligations.verification: Fail-then-pass PostgreSQL tests for resets before and within the window, component regressions and missing baselines.

proof_obligations.claim: MCP output schema, grouping, existing canonical precedence and scope safety remain compatible.
proof_obligations.verification: Unit, protocol, and PostgreSQL integration suites; independent Sol review.
